payload.prompt: My back aches just watching you hack away at herbs with rusty garden shears! Tell me, what enchanted tool should any self-respecting herbalist wield to guarantee a 10% increase to their crop yield?
Good labor doesn't come cheap, adventurer, and neither do my colleagues. If you expect a fellow gardener to keep watchful eyes on a growing Magic tree so it doesn't rot, what will that cost you?
I just packed a Tier 5 seed pack for a farmer who actually bothered finishing their contract. Out of these seeds, which one has the absolute lowest chance of appearing in my top-tier pack?
Don't just stand there trampling my petunias! I have a clipboard full of work to assign! If I request you grow a patch of Kwuarm, which tier of Farming contract are you taking on?

The mighty Hespori rests in a cave in my Guild. Its roots can snap a man in two, and you look like you'd faint at the first sign of poison. Tell me its combat level before you go embarrass yourself again!
Exclusive to the master tier of my guild, this unique tree takes over 13 hours to grow and produces bark coveted by fletchers making battlestaves. What tree is it?
